name: "Janus no Kagami ~VF Bunko Advance~"
source:
Tomomi is an ordinary girl working at a family-style restaurant.
One day, she is suddenly taken to a different world.

She meets a few beautiful women in the darkness.
But they are carted off by monsters in front of her...... Right before she gets caught by the monsters, she manages to escape from there and ends up wandered off into an underground maze....
She tries to escape from the insane maze.
On the way to the only exit, she finds the beautiful women being chained in rooms and humiliated by the monsters...... The castle she is in is there only to have human beings to be pregnant monster's babies to keep the tribe populated. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE028238.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
朋美是一位在家庭式餐厅工作的普通女孩。
有一天，她突然被带到了一个不同的世界。

她在黑暗中遇见了几个美丽的女人。
却被眼前的怪物带走了……就在她被怪物抓住之前，她成功逃脱，结果却误入了地下迷宫……
她试图逃离疯狂的迷宫。
在通往唯一出口的路上，她发现美女被锁在房间里，被怪物羞辱……她所在的城堡只是为了让人类怀孕怪物的婴儿，以维持部落的人口。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE028238.html]DLsite English[/url]]
